title: Daniel 2: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream
body:

This recording ended during [Daniel 1](/bible/daniel/1) because of audio failure, so [Daniel 2](/bible/daniel/2) was not reached in this session. It is recorded here without exposition; the teaching on Nebuchadnezzar's dream and its interpretation belongs to a later recording.
